# CANDIDATE: ribbon-pinch-long

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The ribbon-pinch-long setup captures bearish momentum when the EMA ribbon (fast, pivot, slow) narrows to a spread < 15 cents and then expands downward, indicating compression followed by bearish breakout. This edge exists because low-volatility compression often precedes sustained moves, and the ribbon provides a dynamic trailing stop that adapts to volatility.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when: (1) ribbon spread (slow EMA - fast EMA) <= 0.15 for at least 3 consecutive 3-min bars, (2) the next bar closes below the low of the compression zone with volume >= 1.2x average, (3) EMA ribbon is bearish-stacked (fast < pivot < slow). Exit uses chart-stop-primary: SPY closes a 3-min candle above the entry level + $0.50 buffer, with chandelier profit-lock arming at +5% and trailing 0.15 off high-water mark, and premium stop at -50% catastrophe cap.
